Welcome to Save The Dog! 🐶🐝

How to Play

✏️ Draw a protective line to keep your dog safe.

🐝 Angry bees will swarm toward your dog, so make sure your drawing can survive the attack!

🧠 Use physics, timing, and clever strategies to solve each puzzle.

⭐ Protect your dog long enough to complete the level and unlock brand-new challenges.

🌋 Watch out for new obstacles including lava, spikes, moving platforms, wind, bombs, and more!

🎮 Every level introduces new mechanics, making each puzzle more challenging than the last.

Can you save every dog? 🏆

👍 Like 👍 Favorite ⭐ and Follow to support future updates!
